author: Adolf von Harnack
work: History of Dogma (Lehrbuch der Dogmengeschichte), vol. I
citation_system: volume, chapter, section and numbered paragraph of the English translation
notes: Neil Buchanan's English translation (1894) of the third German edition, consulted in Project Gutenberg ebook 19612. A liberal-Protestant historian's account of the Gospel and the origin of the Church; used in this corpus as the source of the rival reading that Jesus' commission was a message, not the founding of a community.
